featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with the CITYFURNISH app and its services. The company promises smooth delivery and reliable customer support, but in reality, neither of these expectations were met. My order was delayed multiple times without proper updates, and the delivery process felt completely unorganized. Even after making full payment in advance, there was no accountability from their side.

What made the situation worse was the lack of customer support. It is extremely difficult to reach a real person, and responses (when they come) are slow, generic, and unhelpful. It honestly feels like the company focuses on collecting payments quickly but fails to provide the service they advertise.

Overall, the experience felt unprofessional and unreliable. I would strongly advise others to be cautious before using CITYFURNISH, as the service quality and customer care do not match the promises made on the app.
